Package GUI

Class UpdateParkParamsController

java.lang.Object
GUI.UpdateParkParamsController
public class UpdateParkParamsController extends Object
Controller for the Update Park Parameters screen. This class allows a park manager to submit requests for updating park parameters such as capacity, reserved spots, average stay hours, and promotion discount.

  • Method Details

    • initialize

      public void initialize()
      Initializes the screen after the FXML file is loaded. The method loads the park ID, prepares the parameter combo box, configures the request table, and loads existing park update requests.

    • loadRequests

      public void loadRequests()
      Requests all update requests related to the current park from the server.

    • setRequestsTable

      public void setRequestsTable(ArrayList<ArrayList<String>> rows)
      Updates the requests table with data received from the server.
      Parameters:
      rows - the park update request records received from the server

    • handleSubmit

      void handleSubmit(ActionEvent event)
      Submits a new park parameter update request. The method validates the selected parameter and value, converts the selected parameter into the internal request type, and sends the request to the server.
      Parameters:
      event - the button click event
